scores.evidence: chargebacks arrive 30–120 days after the transaction
scores.rationale: Claims about auth timing, label maturity, PCI requirements, tree-model in-process serving, join keys (RRN/STAN/ARN) and training-serving skew are accurate and precise, with real limits stated honestly.

scores.evidence: I've assumed we are an issuer or issuer-processor scoring inline in authorization, so a decline is possible
scores.rationale: Solves exactly the stated problem, resolves the key ambiguity (inline vs post-auth) explicitly with the consequence if wrong, and the phased build is realistically achievable.

scores.evidence: The auth host stays system of record for the auth decision. The existing rules stay as champion and fallback
scores.rationale: Responsibilities and data ownership are unambiguous, interfaces connect (decision API, Kafka, feature store), and choices like fail-open-to-champion are honored consistently across every phase and validation.

scores.evidence: In 100% of ≥ 1,000 injections per fault type, the auth host returns the champion decision inside its timeout
scores.rationale: V0–V8 tie checkable criteria to the specific risks, thresholds are labeled ASSUMPTION with a basis and confirmer, risky items are validated before exposure, and validation continues post-launch (V8, drift, holdout).

scores.evidence: ASSUMPTION for the headroom (basis: seasonal peaks). The peak itself is a BASELINE measured in Phase 0
scores.rationale: Every number is tagged ASSUMPTION/BASELINE/UNKNOWN with a stated basis, missing inputs are ranked by plan impact, and the plan says exactly what flips if each assumption is wrong.

scores.evidence: kill the service, add 200 ms latency, always-decline model output, feature store outage, Kafka outage
scores.rationale: Covers runaway declines, outages, card-testing bursts, label poisoning and adversarial inputs with concrete handling, but duplicate, out-of-order and reversal/refund events in the stream are not addressed.

scores.evidence: Rollback is `helm rollback`, or the auth-host flag off, which stops the call entirely
scores.rationale: Deployment, rehearsed rollback, meaningful alerts, runbook drills, a sized on-call rotation and two-person change control are designed in from Phase 0.

scores.evidence: Storage cost / retention | UNKNOWN. Missing input: how long decision and feature logs must be kept
scores.rationale: The build-vs-buy trade-off, false-decline economics (V6/V8) and CPU/in-process serving choices are costed qualitatively, but infra and people cost magnitudes and growth with volume are not estimated.

scores.evidence: Decommissioning the rules engine (this is the point of no return)… It needs a new gate: a rehearsed champion-off run
scores.rationale: R2/R3 classification with revisit triggers, early validation of R3 items (identifiers via V3, privacy via V1), and explicit exit paths (vendor behind the same API, async flip).

scores.evidence: Sequence or deep models, GPU serving: pull forward when gradient-boosted performance plateaus across two retrains
scores.rationale: Starts with a minimal end-to-end slice, defers multi-region, graph features and deep models behind concrete triggers, and every retained component is justified by a stated need.

scores.evidence: If it fails: trim the hot path; if it still fails, flip to async (§3)
scores.rationale: Dependency-ordered phases, a concrete Phase 0 first step, specific decisions (keys, timeouts, store, model family), checkable exit gates per phase, and explicit fallback plans when results disappoint.

checklist.evidence: p99 ≤ 50 ms; the auth host gives up at 80 ms and falls back
Fall back to the current decision (existing rules plus auth host). Never decline because the scorer timed out or errored
One Flink job definition runs both live and in backfill mode. Every scored feature vector is also logged (log-and-wait)
Out-of-time backtest on the latest 3 matured months (labels ≥ 90 days old)
At equal decline rate, ≥ 10% more fraud value caught than champion BASELINE… false-positive ratio ≤ BASELINE
Policy layer combining rules and model thresholds into an action from the allowed list: APPROVE, APPROVE+CASE, or DECLINE+CASE
Case queue in case management… Ingest labels: chargebacks with fraud reason codes, fraud claims, analyst dispositions
The pipeline sees only a PAN token plus BIN. Sensitive authentication data (CVV, track data, PIN data) is dropped at ingress
Online feature state rebuilt within 1 h by replaying the event stream… Idempotent, re-runnable backfill
Drift monitors: PSI (population stability index) per feature and on the score… challenger that goes through shadow
every decision records model and policy version… reason codes from top SHAP contributions
p99 ≤ 50 ms and stream lag ≤ 1 s p99 at 3× BASELINE peak TPS for 1 h

traps.evidence: A synchronous gRPC score call inside authorization with an 80 ms hard timeout
Never decline because the scorer timed out or errored… A decline-rate circuit breaker that forces champion-only
Train the gradient-boosted model on the backfill with an out-of-time split… labels ≥ 90 days old
One Flink job definition runs both live and in backfill mode… ≥ 99.9% of values match
DLP regex and Luhn scan of every sink (Kafka, Iceberg, logs, traces, metrics labels)

note: An exemplary, assumption-explicit, validation-gated inline fraud plan; the only material gaps are stream event correctness (duplicates/reversals/ordering) and quantified cost reasoning.
